translation: Took place in posad Serock, 14 September 1890, [unclear: 9/10] AM. Appeared personally Abram Frydman, innkeeper, 54, and Berek Kołtun, cemetery attendant, 65, both residing in posad Serock, and declared that yesterday at 11 AM died in posad Serock Ruchla Laja Frydman, resident of the city of Radzymin, Radzymin district, thirty-eight years of age, daughter of Lejba and Sura [unclear: Majta], born in posad Rozan, Makow district, leaving behind her husband [unclear: Bojm/Chaim] Frydman, shopkeeper in posad Serock, and five children. Upon eyewitness certification of the death of Ruchla Laja Frydman this act was read to the witnesses, signed by us and one witness; the second witness is illiterate.
